The chemical-free story

Clean that is kind to lungs, pets, and little hands.

Many homes smell “clean” because of strong chemicals left behind. Fresh Tech Maid takes the other route: effective, chemical-free cleaning that leaves rooms fresh without a chemical residue.

  • Chemical-free products used across the home
  • Trained, W-2 technicians — not day labour
  • Award-led quality, recognised by Best Pick and Angie’s List, per the company’s own site
  • Regular, deep, move-in and post-construction cleaning

Questions

Before you book.

What does chemical-free cleaning mean here?

Cleaning without harsh chemicals, using products chosen to be safer for the people, pets and air in your home — the core of Fresh Tech Maid’s positioning on its own site.

How do I get a price?

Through the online quote form or by calling (847) 392-0888. No fixed price list is published, so your quote is based on your home and the service you choose.

Who cleans my home?

Trained, W-2 technicians, per the company’s own positioning — employed team members, not casual day labour.

Where are you based?
